summary: Termix is a clientless web-based platform for managing remote servers directly from your browser. It provides an interface featuring an SSH terminal, tunneling utilities, and file editing capabilities.
goodFor: System administrators and developers who need a browser-accessible management interface for remote infrastructure without installing local client software.
watchOut: Exposing a web-based terminal and file management interface to the network introduces significant security risks if access controls and authentication are not strictly managed.
deployNotes: Because it runs in Docker, you will typically need to map persistent volumes for configuration data and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
